svg.text: GHOSTED: Auntie Dot body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Decided before the sheet: proportions in head-heights, landmarks, attachment points (bun, headset round the NECK, card in hand), and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright, symmetric)
top of bun y 40
top of hair y 70
hairline (centre) y 88
temple hairline y 112
eye line = ear points y 126
mouth (smile) y 152
chin y 172
neck line = headset band y 180
cup centres (collarbones) y 194
shoulder joint (arm root) y 206
folded hands y 262
belly (widest) y 280
cardigan hem y 316
sole y 340
1 head
B. SIDE (same lines)
C. TOP VIEW, head lifted off:
band behind the neck, a cup on each collarbone
front (face side)
back
PROPORTIONS (head = top of bun to chin = 132 units)
Whole figure 300 units = 2.27 heads (Kit 2.71, Ricky 2.67):
shorter and rounder, same toy-pawn family.
Size: 0.9 x Kit on screen = 67.5 px; estimate 1.00 m (1 u = 3.34 mm).
Head 112 wide (skull 98 tall); body: a pear, 32 wide at
the neck, 164 at the belly (y 280); legs 18; shoes 16.
LANDMARKS
Hairline: soft waves, y 88 at the centre, y 112 at the
temples; strands swept up into the top-back bun.
Eye line y 126; eyes x 132 / 168 (ink ovals + glint).
Ears: on the eye line at the head sides (x 93 / 207),
in the open: the headset is NOT on them.
Mouth zone x 134-166, y 140-160: warm smile; opens
to talk. No creases (noise at 1x).
Neck: short, chin y 172 to the body top y 180.
Shoulder joint (red): x 90 / 210, y 206. Continuous
sleeve from the body, then the hand ball.
Hands: folded on the belly at y 262 (rest pose).
ATTACHMENT POINTS (red)
Bun: centre (0, y 60, 18 behind the head centre).
Headset band: round the NECK at the neck line y 180,
behind the neck (back point y 183), on the shoulders.
Headset cups: ONE ON EACH COLLARBONE, at the band
ends: centre x 117 / 183, y 194, faces forward.
No mic. Faded row 27 (the Ghostie accessory colour).
Skill card: in her right hand (talk / card poses).
E. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3, 1x below). Left: Dot estimate. Middle: landmark dots (blue: eyes, mouth, hairline, ears, button, hands, hem, feet;
red: bun, band back, cups). Right: Kit, real v7 render. Net yaw 5 (lineup facing), pitch 42.
Hairline above the eye top at 1x: left 6.8 px, right 6.8 px (the hair never crosses the eyes).
Bun centre 23.2 px above the eyes; it sits on the crown, behind.
Cups 11.1 px under the eyes, 6.7 px under the mouth: under the chin, not hidden by it.
Band back point: 2.8 px above the eye line on screen, so the head hides it (as it hides a real neck band). The band sides and the cups show.
Read: a white bun on a white dome, a peach face with two dots and a smile, two lilac discs
under the chin, a purple pear. The lilac reads as a ring at the neck (brief L24).
